topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
response: For SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas, there exists a trade-off between array size and radiation efficiency. As the array size increases, the length of SIW also increases, leading to higher insertion loss, which can drastically reduce the radiation efficiency from 70% to 27.5%. This relationship is observed for sub-arrays with sizes up to 32x32.
